posts.title: Bringing The Oredigger Home
posts.description: Drafted with Claude Opus 5.5 . I rescued 1 my old articles for The Oredigger, the Colorado School of Mines student newspaper, from the Colorado Historic Newspapers Collection . They have a rather impressive archive of the paper, scanned from 1921 to 2012. It’s actually pretty cool that they scanned our tiny paper and made it searchable in various ways.
